sentences.text:
Asif Jafar Shaikh vs State Of Maharashtra on 21 September,
2023

Author: N.J.Jamadar
Bench: N.J.Jamadar
 902 aba 2660 of 2023.
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Anticipatory Bail Application No.2660 Of 2023
Asif Jafar Shaikh ... Applicant
 versus
The State of Maharashtra ... Respondent
Mr. Aamir Shaikh, for Applicant.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Ms. Pallavi N. Dabholkar, App for State.
Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R.No.168 of 2023 registered with
Rabodi Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 272, 273, read with Section 34
of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(2)(i), 27(3)(e), 26(2)(iv), 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and
Standards Act, 2006.

3. The learned Counsel for the Applicant submits that the co-accused was found in possession of the contraband articles - Gutkha Panmasala and on the basis of the statement of the co-accused, the applicant has been roped in.
4. In matters involving identical allegations, this Court has granted interim protection and posted those matters on 3 October 2023.

In the meanwhile, in the event of the arrest of the applicant - Asif Jafar 902 aba 2660 of 2023.doc Shaikh in connection with C.R.No.168 of 2023 registered with Rabodi Police Station, the Applicant be released on bail on furnishing a PR bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in Asif Jafar Shaikh vs State Of Maharashtra on 21 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104625162/
1 the like amount.

sentences.text: 7. The Applicant shall co-operate with the investigation and report to Rabodi Police Station on every alternate Saturday from 10.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m. till the next date.
8. The applicant shall not indulge in identical activities for which he has been arraigned in this case.
9. The Applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and/or give threat or inducement to any of the prosecution witnesses and the persons acquainted with the facts of the case.

( N.J.JAMADAR, J. ) Signed by: S.S.Phadke Designation: PS To Honourable Judge Date:
